news.text: LUCIO CALLS #JUVE14 points and 7th placeHe beats #DiFra 2-0 without 9 players: "We won for those who have this club at heart".He conquers #Lecce and bites back: "We need to put more into it".#Mckennie and #DouglasLuiz seal the deal in 41 minutes. "A very serious first half, in the second we dropped deep". Wednesday night the test at Marassi.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, AND #LUIZ IT WASDouglas is a protagonist again and together with #McKennie brings back the victory, reassuring #Spalletti and the fans.#Lecce was never scary, the bianconeri stuck to business, avoiding silly mistakes: #Woltemade and #Kolo didn't make an impact, but 6th place is reached again with #Frosinone that got a sensational 4-4 with #Atalanta. Lucio: "With the 3-5-2, we don't concede counterattacks anymore. Now I hope I can sleep. But if I think about the second half, I wake right up..."[Front Page TuttoSport]
